titleEn: Law on the Establishment of Ministry of Women's and Veteran's Affairs

articles.en:
.. The Ministry of Women’s Affairs and Veterans is hereby established under the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
Article 2. ..
The Ministry of Women’s Affairs and Veterans shall have the competence to lead and administer the women’s affairs and veterans sector of the Kingdom of Cambodia.

- The Ministry of Women’s Affairs and Veterans shall be led by a Minister, who may be assisted by Secretaries of State and/or Under-Secretaries of State as necessary. The organisational structure and functioning of the Ministry of Women’s Affairs and Veterans shall be determined by sub-decree.

.
All provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void. This Law is declared to be urgent.
Phnom Penh, 18 June 1999.
For the King’s signature, submitted
to Norodom Sihanouk.
For the King’s signature; First Prime Minister, signature: Sar Kheng; No. 254 NS/RK; certified true copy, Phnom Penh, [date illegible] 1999.
